- Build a complete, playable top-down 2D game inspired by Pokémon, where philosophers battle.

- Created a browser-based game called **THOUGHTBOUND**, set in the Meadow of Ideas, with philosopher companions, exploration, and turn-based debate battles.
- Added keyboard and touch movement, philosopher selection, a party, wild encounters, trainer battles, and progress toward a three-thinker milestone.

- `style.css`: Desktop and mobile game styling.
- `game.js`: World map, movement, philosopher party, encounters, battles, and progress.

- Build and verify THOUGHTBOUND, a playable top-down philosopher-adventure game.
- Make the game controller friendly.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) and inspect only the latest.

- The game uses keyboard and touch movement, philosopher companions, exploration, encounters, and turn-based debate battles.
- Controller support is being added for navigation and actions, with visible controller guidance planned.

- Implemented game interface and gameplay in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`.
- Verified the completion flow: defeating Nietzsche reaches `3 / 3`, fills the party to `04 / 04`, and displays the ending screen; “Keep Exploring” closes it.

- Finish visible controller guidance in `index.html` and responsive styling in `style.css`.
- Test controller interactions and inspect the latest screenshot.

- (none)

2. Check held-direction movement: current polling only moves on a direction change, so holding a direction appears to move only one tile.
3. Test gamepad and keyboard flows, run `node --check game.js`, and inspect the latest screenshot.

- `index.html`: Game UI, overlays, controls and gameplay hints.
- `game.js`: Movement, interactions, battles, and new gamepad polling.
- `style.css`: Desktop and mobile layout and control styling.
- `screenshots/current.jpg`: Latest previously inspected game screenshot.
